capture_gap_diagnostic.alerts: Alert captures are change-only after collector content deduplication.
capture_gap_diagnostic.boundary_gaps: Time before the first and after the last archive capture is not inferred.
capture_gap_diagnostic.interpretation: Content deduplication can create gaps; these are not proven collection outages.
capture_gap_diagnostic.measurement: Consecutive archived collector captures before sampling.

limitations: Both derivations originate from the same MTA feed; no independent physical arrivals were supplied.
Vehicle timestamps describe observations or last movement, not a verified arrival event.
Sampling can miss short station stops; compared transitions are a selected subset.
Bracket agreement is a consistency check and is not a model accuracy metric.

global_integrity.count_semantics: Exact distinct qualified trips and stop/segment events across all parts; repeated predictions are rows, not independent journeys.

limitations: Arrival and segment labels derive from final prediction journals, not physical ground truth.
Vehicle-status checks use a different derivation of the same MTA source, not independent observations.
Only configured target stations, routes, horizons and sampled collection times are included.
Only two weekends are present; chronological validation contains weekdays only.
No historical Google route predictions or defensible full passenger journey outcomes are supplied.
Historical alert captures are content-deduplicated; old last-observed alerts do not establish fresh current alert state.
No model has been trained and no prediction accuracy or realized time saving has been established.
